notes: Sister property to The Panari Hotel Nairobi in the same contract document - see panari-hotel-nairobi-2026.json for the Nairobi property and shared general terms.
Three seasonal NETT rate tables plus a separate Rack card, all for the same 3 room types: Cottage, Villa (3-bedroom), Presidential.
Villa and Presidential rates are flat per-room regardless of Single/Double/Triple occupancy label (same figure repeated across all three columns) - i.e. priced per unit, not per person.
Game package supplement of US$121pps is constant across all seasons and room types.
Christmas period (22 Dec 2026-3 Jan 2027) has a separate supplement, distinct from the seasonal rate tables' own date windows.

villa3BR.note: Priced per unit; the FB/HB and Single/Double/Triple headers appear to apply nominally but the source repeats 650 across all Full Board columns and 0 across all Half Board columns for this row - treat as a flat per-villa Full Board rate; Half Board not offered for the Villa at this tier.

presidential.note: Same structure as Villa - flat per-unit Full Board rate; Half Board 0/not offered.

rack_perRoomPerNight.confidenceNote: [Unverified] Cottage Half Board Triple rack figure reads '297' with a stray '7' wrapped onto the next line in the source table ('29' then '7' on following row) - reconstructed as 297, flag if it looks wrong.

gamePackageIncludes: Transport for game drives at Solio Ranch. Park fees paid directly at the entrance (not included).

activities_perPerson_min2people.item: Nature Walk to Marmanet Forest (early morning/late evening)
Thomson Falls Guided Tour + Hippo Pool Walk & Birdwatching

christmasSupplement.raw: 22 Dec 2026 - 3 Jan 2027: US$20 per person per day; child supplement US$10

circuitDiscount.raw: Groups staying at both Panari Hotel Nairobi and Panari Resort Nyahururu enjoy a further 5% circuit discount - must be stated in booking voucher.

generalTermsReference: See panari-hotel-nairobi-2026.json for shared child policy, day-use policy, cancellation policy, and other Tour Operator Agreement terms - identical contract covers both properties.
